workflow.title: Shipping FAQ replies, urgent tickets to Mike, daily digest
workflow.goal: For open support tickets: reply to tickets mentioning 'shipping' with the shipping FAQ answer; send urgent open tickets to mike@fitzone.com; send all other open tickets to Mike in one daily digest.

assumptions: A ticket is urgent when its priority is 'urgent'.
Only open tickets are handled; closed tickets are ignored.
A ticket 'mentions shipping' when its subject or body contains the word 'shipping' (case-insensitive).
Shipping replies are sent to the ticket's from address via outbox.send, one per shipping ticket, with subject 'Re: <ticket subject>'.
The daily digest covers all open non-urgent tickets, including shipping tickets.
Urgent alert and digest are sent to Mike every run; the urgent alert says 'No urgent tickets today.' when there are none, so the recipient count stays fixed for the audit.
risks: outbox.send asks a person before every dispatch, so each shipping reply and Mike email needs approval when live.
Replies are sent to customers automatically once approved; a wrong ticket match would send the FAQ to the wrong person.
Two Mike emails per day even when empty.
successCriteria: Every open ticket mentioning 'shipping' receives the shipping FAQ reply via outbox.send.
Every open urgent ticket is listed in an email to mike@fitzone.com.
Every other open ticket appears in one daily digest email to mike@fitzone.com.
outbox.audit confirms recipients and message hashes.
